prompt: Which two MLB teams played in the World Series just weeks after the O.J. Simpson murder trial had ended?
answer: The **Atlanta Braves and Cleveland Indians** played in the **1995 World Series**, which began just weeks after O.J. Simpson’s murder trial ended. The Braves won the series, four games to two.
